summary: Skyreach Spires are towering floating structures suspended by elemental wind currents. Skybridges, windwells, and aerial plazas form the foundation of the Air Region’s ancient architecture.
history: Formed when primordial winds condensed into stable floating structures.
Skybridges grew as elemental currents intertwined over millennia.
Windwell chambers developed from pressure pockets within the floating spires.
The Skyreach Sovereign emerged as the guardian of the upper air currents.
